records.title: Attendee and organizer web client

records.capturedStatement: Client provides cached agenda/bookmarks plus connected organizer editing and conflict comparison.

records.title: Operations telemetry pipeline

records.capturedStatement: Collects structured delivery health and redacts personal data; diagnostic identifiers follow a proposed retention policy.

records.title: Event backend

records.title: Check-in operation API v1
records.statement: POST /events/{event}/check-ins accepts operationId, attendeeId, gateId and clientObservedAt. Replaying one operation returns its stored disposition; an independent scan can produce a distinct conflict.

fields.compatibility: Server operation identity is scoped to event and issuing device. Retention of replay keys must exceed the supported retry window.

records.capturedStatement: GET /events/{event}/agenda returns agendaVersion, generatedAt and session entries. Conditional fetch permits reuse of a downloaded version.

records.capturedStatement: POST /events/{event}/agenda-edits includes baseVersion and proposed field edits; responds with the new version or an explicit conflict containing the current values.

records.capturedStatement: Authorized pack includes rosterVersion, agendaVersion, event identity, expiresAt and an offline authorization envelope; partial downloads are not committed as ready.

records.title: AgendaPublished event v1
records.statement: Event includes eventId, agendaVersion and publication time; consumers fetch the snapshot rather than treating notification receipt as synchronized state.
records.capturedStatement: Event includes eventId, agendaVersion and publication time; consumers fetch the snapshot rather than treating notification receipt as synchronized state.

records.title: DeliveryHealth diagnostic event v1
records.statement: Event includes operation ID, retry category and lag bucket; excludes attendee identity and payload contents. Retention and redaction are draft decisions.
records.capturedStatement: Event includes operation ID, retry category and lag bucket; excludes attendee identity and payload contents. Retention and redaction are draft decisions.

records.title: Commit local state and outbox together
records.statement: Use one local transaction for a provisional scan and its outgoing operation. Persist the operation ID before acknowledging capture.
records.capturedStatement: Use one local transaction for a provisional scan and its outgoing operation. Persist the operation ID before acknowledging capture.

fields.context: A phone may lose power between UI acknowledgment and network delivery.
fields.alternatives: Send first; save a volatile retry queue; persist record and queue separately.
fields.consequences: Requires durable local storage and queue migration; protects against a stranded acknowledged local scan.

records.title: Reuse operation IDs and separate admission conflicts
records.statement: Preserve the same operation ID across transport retries. Server stores replay dispositions, while different operation IDs for the same attendee trigger an admission-conflict workflow.
records.capturedStatement: Preserve the same operation ID across transport retries. Server stores replay dispositions, while different operation IDs for the same attendee trigger an admission-conflict workflow.

fields.context: Timeouts do not tell the client whether a server write succeeded; another gate may scan the same attendee independently.
fields.alternatives: New ID per retry; deduplicate only by attendee; last write wins.
fields.consequences: Replay-key retention and conflict handling require separate policies; expiry remains an open contract issue.

records.title: Last-write-wins organizer edits — retired
records.statement: Earlier fictional prototype proposed accepting the latest timestamped schedule edit.
records.capturedStatement: Earlier fictional prototype proposed accepting the latest timestamped schedule edit.

fields.context: An early single-organizer assumption hid concurrent editing.
fields.consequences: Silently drops another organizer's room/time change; replaced by ADR-04.

records.title: Use version conflicts for schedule publishing
records.statement: Reject organizer edits based on an old agenda version and require explicit comparison before publication.
records.capturedStatement: Reject organizer edits based on an old agenda version and require explicit comparison before publication.

fields.context: Two organizers may edit the same session concurrently.
fields.alternatives: Timestamp last write wins; lock all editing; field-level merge without review.
fields.consequences: Adds conflict UI and connected publish step; offline agenda reading remains available.

records.title: Expire offline roster access explicitly
records.statement: Issue a bounded offline authorization envelope and show expiry before a volunteer starts a shift.
records.capturedStatement: Issue a bounded offline authorization envelope and show expiry before a volunteer starts a shift.

fields.context: Server revocation cannot immediately reach a disconnected phone.
fields.alternatives: Require network for every scan; indefinite offline authorization.
fields.consequences: Expiry bounds exposure but may block a long outage; actual duration and threat review remain open.

records.title: Queue telemetry without personal payloads
records.statement: Diagnostic events use operation IDs and categorized errors with explicit redaction before enqueueing.
records.capturedStatement: Diagnostic events use operation IDs and categorized errors with explicit redaction before enqueueing.

fields.context: Support needs correlation without creating a second attendee-data repository.
fields.alternatives: Raw request logging; no delivery diagnostics.
fields.consequences: Some debugging detail is lost; redaction tests and retention policy are incomplete.
